sources.name: Public information on establishments subject to COMAH 2015
sources.published_or_current: Current official search route reviewed 22 July 2026
sources.required_transform: Resolve exact establishment record, normalise postcode/address, geocode with provenance, then apply a documented distance or official impact-zone method.
sources.usage_limit: COMAH status proves regulatory scope and published controls; it does not establish equal exposure or accident probability for nearby parcels.

sources.publisher: Health and Safety Executive / COMAH Competent Authority
sources.name: COMAH 2015 Public Information Record
sources.location_binding: specific establishment address, tier, activities and public hazard information
sources.required_transform: Bind only after exact establishment identity; retain tier, record identifier and retrieval date; use official emergency/consultation zones when available.
sources.usage_limit: An individual record is not a parcel hazard radius and must not be converted into a generic buffer without authoritative consequence-zone evidence.

sources.name: Public Registers Online — all registers
sources.published_or_current: Current official register and API routes reviewed 22 July 2026
sources.location_binding: business name, permit number, local authority or address
sources.required_transform: Select the correct register, preserve registration/permit identifier, site or mobile status, address and licence conditions; geocode only site-specific records.
sources.usage_limit: Register presence proves an authorisation or registration, not current pollution, non-compliance or parcel exposure.

sources.name: Environmental Permitting Regulations — Waste Operations
sources.published_or_current: Current official search and complete-register download route reviewed 22 July 2026
sources.location_binding: permit holder, permit number, local authority, address or postcode distance search
sources.required_transform: Distinguish fixed sites from mobile plant, retain permit status and documents, normalise exact address/postcode and exclude mobile-only records from parcel proximity.
sources.usage_limit: A waste permit authorises specified activities; it is not evidence of an incident, breach, nuisance or uniform local risk.

sources.name: Environmental Permitting Regulations — Installations
sources.published_or_current: Current official search and complete-register download route reviewed 22 July 2026
sources.location_binding: industrial installation permit, address, postcode and selectable distance
sources.required_transform: Match exact installation and permit, retain CAR/document availability and status, geocode the regulated site rather than operator registered office.
sources.usage_limit: A permit or CAR document does not by itself quantify emissions, compliance severity or parcel impact.

sources.name: Environmental Permitting Regulations — Discharges to Water and Groundwater
sources.published_or_current: Current official search and complete-register download route reviewed 22 July 2026
sources.location_binding: permit holder, discharge permit, address, postcode and distance
sources.required_transform: Resolve exact permit and discharge location; distinguish operator address from outfall; join receiving-water geometry and permit conditions before any spatial interpretation.
sources.usage_limit: Authorisation of a discharge does not prove pollution occurrence, exceedance or parcel-level health risk.

sources.name: Environmental Permitting Regulations — Radioactive Substances
sources.published_or_current: Current official search and complete-register download route reviewed 22 July 2026
sources.location_binding: permit holder, permit number, local authority, address or postcode distance
sources.required_transform: Match exact permitted organisation and site, retain activity and permit scope, verify whether the address is the regulated location before geocoding.
sources.usage_limit: A radioactive-substances permit is a regulatory record and does not establish a release, dose or parcel hazard.

sources.name: ONR sites and facilities map
sources.location_binding: regulated site or facility map location
sources.required_transform: Resolve the mapped site to the licence register, retain site/facility type and map version, and avoid treating a display point as the legal licensed boundary.
sources.usage_limit: The map identifies regulated locations; display geometry is not necessarily the legal site perimeter or an emergency zone.

sources.name: Register of nuclear site licences
sources.location_binding: licensed site title, address/postcode, licence number and grant date
sources.required_transform: Bind by licence number and exact site address; obtain the legal licence map where parcel-boundary intersection is required.
sources.usage_limit: The register identifies licensed sites but the address alone does not define the legal boundary or radiological consequence area.

sources.name: Land use planning around nuclear sites
sources.location_binding: licensed-site boundary, DEPZ, OCZ and documented 12 km consultation zone
sources.required_transform: Use site-specific DEPZ/OCZ geometry or authorised centre point and current consultation criteria; record zone type and edition.
sources.usage_limit: Consultation zones support planning and emergency-arrangement decisions; they are not continuous risk probabilities or safety scores.

sources.name: CQC API and care-location directory
sources.published_or_current: Page updated 2 July 2026; API updated daily and directory files normally weekly/monthly
sources.location_binding: active/inactive provider and location identifiers, service name and address
sources.required_transform: Use CQC location ID, active/archived status, service type, address and data date; geocode with provenance and separate service rating from physical accessibility.
sources.usage_limit: Registration or rating describes a regulated service; it is not guaranteed emergency availability, travel time or parcel safety.

sources.name: Fire and Rescue Authorities December 2022 boundaries, England
sources.published_or_current: Official boundary dataset last updated 21 July 2025
sources.required_transform: Point-in-polygon join the canonical parcel point to the authority code, retain boundary date/resolution and then join only compatible authority-level statistics.
sources.usage_limit: Authority membership is an administrative geography and does not measure station proximity, response time or parcel fire risk.
